verdict.rationale: SolidJS is a self-hosted, open-source UI framework and library, not a hosted service that stores user data. Choosing a storage region or data residency is therefore a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows SolidJS running any first-party data storage whose location could be chosen.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
